This module enables an authentication at the MFP to provide the following functions: 
-

- 
Tracking of the copying and scanning 
- 
Functionality of scan to email or home directory

2.1.3.2 
Access rights (RBAC) 
Roles based access is to enable only in the following cases: 
- 
If you wish to apply different access rights to the MFP functions according to the user. 
In this case, access rights per user are defined at Gespage configuration. 
- 
If you wish to enable a guest account with limited rights. 
In this case, access rights for the guest user are defined

rights to the MFP functions according to the user. 
In this case, access rights per user are defined at Gespage configuration. 
- 
If you wish to enable a guest account with limited rights. 
In this case, access rights for the guest user are defined in TopAccess (account Guest from 
the User Management /Role management menu). 
- 
If you wish to enable the card association per user with limited accounts. 
In this case, the limitation will lock all the copier functions of a user in process of Card 
Association. 
This parameter is commonly known as RBAC (Role Based ACcess). 
Locking colour copies is an example of limitation. 
2.1.3.2.1 Recording RBAC roles 
 
RBAC configuration of Gespage must be recorded in the MFP from the User Management / Export / 
Import menu. 
 
For this, 2 configuration files have to be imported in the following order (Be careful of the right 
order!): 
- 
Import the file USER_ROLE_GROUP_02.xml to the Combined (User Information (All Counter) 
+ Role + Group) menu. 
- 
Import the file LDAP_Role_Mapping_02.xml to the Export (LDAP Role) menu.

2.1.6 Cloning of the MFP configuration 
The configuration of a MFP correctly configured for Gespage may be cloned (and imported) from the 
Administration / Maintenance / Create Clone File (Install Clone file) menu. 
 
Only the setting of Gespage directory service must be adapted to each MFP to fill in the right printer 
name in the Search Base and User Name fields. 
 
ATTENTION! Configuration of cloning may not be reliable if MFPs do not have the same firmware. 
2.2 Gespage configuration 
2.2.1 General 
2.2.1.1 
Architecture 
In addition to Gespage standard services, 2 additional services are used for handling of Toshiba 
eTerminal. 
 
 
eTerminal service [Gespage eTerminal service]: Handles the user’s sessions at the MFP. 
 
LDAP service [Gespage LDAP Service]: Handles user’s authentication (of LDAP type) for 
Toshiba MFP. 
2.2.1.2 
Network flows 
Toshiba eTerminal communicates with Gespage server on TCP ports 7180/7181 and on Gespage 
LDAP port (10389 by default).

Configuration 
 
Gespage eTerminal Toshiba Manual - 002 
 
19
2.2.2 eTerminal configuration 
Before configuring your eTerminal, you first have to configure the MFP print queue on your Gespage 
server. 
 
Then, you have to configure your eTerminal in Gespage, and link it to the corresponding MFP print 
queue. 
 
It is in this menu that you configure job release mode and eTerminal accounting options (copy, scan, 
and fax).

In the Toshiba eTerminal general configuration menu are configured the parameters to be applied to 
all eTerminal on the site. 
 
Among these parameters is the Gespage LDAP proxy configuration, the card association mode, or the 
eTerminal locale.

Toshiba card association parameters 
Association card ID to user 
At the first user’s card use and if the card number is not known by Gespage, a method of 
association of the card must be defined. It enables the number of the user’s card to be stored in 
Gespage account. This association only applies a

ID to user 
At the first user’s card use and if the card number is not known by Gespage, a method of 
association of the card must be defined. It enables the number of the user’s card to be stored in 
Gespage account. This association only applies at the first card insertion. 
1. Done by the user 
When a user will use an unknown card, he will have the possibility of entering his 
login/password instead of the menu usually showing pending jobs. The self-association 
of the card will be required only once during the card life time. 
2. Done by the administrator 
All the card numbers of the users have to first be configured in Gespage. The 
initialization can be carried out by the administrator or the LDAP synchronization 
mechanism. 
 
Time out for card association (sec) 
It is the time out in seconds for entering login/password for card association after having swiped 
the card. After this delay, card association will be ignore by the server. 
 
Toshiba account parameters 
Allow negative balance in GUI 
For limited accounts with a negative balance, if this parameter is enabled, the pending jobs list is 
displayed. Otherwise, an insufficient credit message is displayed to the user. 
 
Minimum value of account to login 
For limited accounts, it is the minimum balance to allow copy, scan, or fax. 
 
Maximum number of printouts in GUI 
This parameter limits the number of print jobs displayed in the job list menu (in case of MFP 
memory limitation). 
 
Allow unknown user to print 
This parameter can be useful when RBAC is enabled, in case the MFP is analyzing the username 
in the spool file. 
 
Device locale 
 
This parameter sets the locale of the Gespage user interface on the MFP.
